method: Public web search and public URL retrieval. Indexed previews are discovery evidence, not original rule files.

reviews.scope: Indexed public preview, not downloaded PDF
reviews.result: Preview discusses misprints, general movement, shuffle initiative, occupied Area definition and Boss Room setup. It is not proven to be filepage 250715. No Necromancer closure may use it; Boss Room setup does not settle Boss trio cleanup.
HTTP 200 body has unrelated DEWI11 gambling platform title, no Darkest/FAQ/download links. Current domain response rejected as publisher rules authority.

reviews.scope: Retrieved HTML title and relevant links
reviews.result: Red Hook home page returned; video game links and news, no restored board game notice or corpus link. This is not an updated tabletop rulebook.
ZIP identities and uploader observed; no byte match to backer originals. Expansion inspection is only for cross-cutting rules, not implementing other Boss families.
Explicit house rules and rewrites. Its suggested precedence is excluded from authoritative closure.
Article points to the same official historical URL that remains unavailable; original backer distribution receipt still needed.

Publisher co-creator claim located, later 2023 update dated. Original mod file/version and publisher identity have not been authenticated; removed listing does not prove permanent source unavailability. Physical structure alone cannot supersede tabletop semantics.
Antha-created current Complete Edition is community transport/structural context; thanks to publisher/IP holder does not make scripts or nicknames rule authority.
